title: Tentative Detection of Neutral Gas in a Little Red Dot at z = 4.46
question: Characterize the molecular and neutral gas reservoirs, dust continuum, and dynamical masses of the host galaxies of Little Red Dots (LRDs) at z=3.10-7.04.

evidence.quote: We targeted three LRDs with existing (spectroscopic) redshifts from *JWST*: RUBIES-BLAGN-1 at $z=3.1034$ (cite: wangRUBIES2024a), A2744-45924 at $z=4.4655$ (cite: labbeUnambiguous2024), and A2744-QSO1 at $z=7.0367$ (cite: furtakHigh2024).

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image ALMA datacubes and continuum maps
recipe.method: Adopt standard ALMA pipeline calibration and perform custom imaging with tclean using natural weighting, auto-multithresh automasking, and native channel width.

recipe.goal: Derive dust continuum flux and dust mass upper limits
recipe.method: Measure continuum RMS in maps and derive 3sigma upper limits on dust mass in the optically-thin Rayleigh-Jeans tail following Scoville et al. (2016).
assumptions: T_dust = 25 K and dust emissivity index beta = 1.8
Lensing magnification correction for A2744-QSO1 (mu=6.2 for A, mu=7.3 for B)

recipe.goal: Extract 1D spectra, create moment-0 map, and fit [CI](2-1) line profile in A2744-45924
recipe.method: Integrate over four channels at the ~3.9sigma spectral peak to make moment-0 map (4.9sigma integrated SNR), extract 1D spectrum at peak position, and fit with a Gaussian line profile using emcee.

recipe.goal: Derive molecular gas masses and upper limits from CO(7-6) and [CI](2-1)
recipe.method: Convert line fluxes and 3sigma upper limits to line luminosities L' and scale to H2 masses using both standard quasar and conservative Milky Way/SMG conversion factors for CO(7-6), and empirical conversion factor for [CI](2-1).
assumptions: Assumed line width of 300 km/s for non-detected lines
Standard quasar assumptions: alpha_CO = 0.8 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1 and L'_CO(7-6)/L'_CO(1-0) = 0.60
Conservative assumptions: alpha_CO = 4.5 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1 and L'_CO(7-6)/L'_CO(1-0) = 0.1
[CI]-to-H2 conversion factor alpha_[CI](2-1) = 34 with 0.4 dex uncertainty

recipe.goal: Estimate dynamical mass of A2744-45924 from [CI](2-1) kinematics
recipe.method: Calculate M_dyn = 5 * R_e * sigma^2 / G using the [CI] velocity dispersion and effective radius, multiplied by 3/2 to account for unknown inclination.
assumptions: Fiducial effective radius R_e ~ 700 pc from extended NIRCam component; conservative upper limit R_e < 4.8 kpc from ALMA beam HWHM
Inclination correction factor of 3/2 (reciprocal of expectation value of sin^2(i))
